# OpenProgram

> OpenProgram is a self-programming AI agent framework. Agents create, run, and refine their own workflows while the runtime manages models, tools, memory, context, and multi-agent collaboration.

## Start

- [Website](https://openprogram.io/): Product overview and quick start
- [Documentation](https://openprogram.io/docs/): Complete documentation index
- [Repository](https://github.com/Fzkuji/OpenProgram): Source code, issues, and discussions
- [Installation](https://openprogram.io/#quick-start): Install and run OpenProgram

## Core concepts

- [Self-Programming AI Agents](https://openprogram.io/docs/capabilities/agentic-programming/self-programming-ai-agents.html): How agents create and refine workflows
- [Agentic Programming](https://openprogram.io/docs/capabilities/agentic-programming/philosophy.html): Program-governed agent execution
- [Framework Comparison](https://openprogram.io/docs/comparisons/ai-agent-frameworks.html): OpenProgram, LangGraph, AutoGen, and CrewAI
- [Feature Matrix](https://openprogram.io/docs/reference/design/feature-matrix.html): Capability-level comparison
- [Runtime API](https://openprogram.io/docs/reference/api/runtime.html): Runtime reference

## Research

- [LLM-as-Code: Agentic Programming for Agent Harness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15874)
